profile.headline: Cloud Architect | Azure & AWS | Senior Software Engineer | Driving Innovation in Enterprise Development
profile.summary:
As a technically proficient and solutions-driven Senior Software Engineer, I bring a wealth of experience in cloud-native solutions and enterprise-scale application development. I have a proven track record of leading successful cloud migrations and optimizing CI/CD pipelines to enhance deployment efficiency. My expertise lies in planning, executing, and overseeing complex transformative projects that optimize performance and scalability, including secure, scalable architecture design and adherence to best practices in software engineering.

Throughout my career, I have driven innovation in the FinTech and credit union sectors by implementing secure Service Oriented Architectures (SOA) and maintaining rigorous compliance standards. My leadership skills have enabled me to build and guide high-performing teams, and my technical proficiency has allowed me to resolve intricate engineering challenges efficiently.

I am skilled in various technical proficiencies, including Microsoft Azure (Azure DevOps, Service Fabric, SQL, Elastic Pools, Application Insights, Front Door, Gateway, Service Bus, App Services, API Management, Entra, Functions), and AWS (SNS, SQS, S3, Lambda, Step Functions). My programming languages include C#, JavaScript, and Java, and I have expertise in frameworks such as .Net Core, MVC4, React, Xamarin, and ASP.Net. Additionally, I have experience with containerization using Docker, Azure Service Fabric, and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud.

I excel in infrastructure automation tooling, full-stack architecture, product performance optimization, and regulatory compliance. My approach is always aligned with best practices in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and enterprise client management. I am passionate about leveraging my skills in dynamic, collaborative environments and am open to remote or hybrid roles that challenge my technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.

Let’s connect if you are looking for someone who can bring technical innovation and robust solutions to your organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Remote

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
In this role I worked to convert over a dozen backend services hosted in Azure Durable functions into containerized services hosted in multi cloud environments. This work also entailed the conversion of pipelines, repositories, and solution architecture to become cloud agnostic. 

Technologies involved
• Azure - Pipelines, Repositories, Durable Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, Api Management, Key Vault, Kubernetes and other infrastructure.
• AWS - SNS, SQS, Secret Manager, App Configuration, Kubernetes, and S3,
• Atlassian - Bit bucket, Confluence, and Jira,
• C# - Utilizing Microservice, Saga, Mediator, and Clean architectural patterns.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
During this tenure, I am leveraging Microsoft technologies including C#, .Net Core, Azure DevOps, Redis, SQL, and various Azure utilities for the development of scalable SOA solutions. Additionally, I am delivering high-level support to teams in preparing the budget and developing a management system to enable automated and standardized development of large physical engineering projects.

To meet and surpass project requirements, I am executing comprehensive solution architectures. Furthermore, to uncover and mitigate potential security risks I am monitoring and confirming a secure application development and deployment.

The key achievements of this role have been:
• Monitored and enabled successful migration from on-premises and cloud-based VMs to a fully cloud-native solution architecture while transforming the company's development strategy.
• Established a CI/CD pipeline that significantly improved the efficiency and effectiveness of build, test, and release processes.
• Ensured code excellence by performing meticulous code reviews that promoted consistency and adherence to best practices.
• Utilized Azure services including App Services, API Management, SQL, Elastic Pools, Gateway, Front Door, Entra, and Docker; leveraged Azure DevOps extensively for continuous integration and deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure Cloud Architecture and Services · ASP.NET MVC · Version Control · REST APIs · Microsoft Azure · Serverless Computing · ASP.NET · C# · Cloud Migration Strategies · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Azure Active Directory · Azure DevOps

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
During this role, I was asked to build and lead a new team within Amazon's FinTech division to drive innovative solutions. Furthermore, I authored comprehensive technical write-ups on various technologies, as well as ensured the seamless integration and training of future engineers as the team continued to grow through detailed onboarding documentation.

The key achievements of this role have been:
• Planned and led the development of two new FinTech products focused on processing disputes and transaction adjustments, utilizing cloud-native and serverless AWS components.
positions.insights: Skills: Version Control · REST APIs · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon SQS · AWS Lambda · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS)

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
In this role, I spearheaded a project to move our business applications to the cloud using Azure. Moreover, I supported and drove the migration of services and systems to Azure, leveraging tools like Application Insights (monitoring), API Management (security & integration), and Service Fabric (container orchestration).

Key achievements of this role have been:
• Received fast-track promotion from Software Engineer to Senior Application Engineer.
• Managed fault tolerances and partial failures, pioneering an asynchronous Saga pattern for robust communication.
• Introduced cloud-based resources in Azure to establish infrastructure as code and ensure highly available systems.
• Developed and implemented end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for lower environments using GIT within Azure DevOps.
• Designed a robust SoA solution using an Orchestrator pattern; orchestrated data delivery across multiple systems.
• Orchestrated the development of the credit union's largest integration system, managing workflows comprising 30 to 250 transactional calls across diverse FinTech systems.
• Protected sensitive information throughout the development and deployment processes by analyzing and maintaining strict adherence to PCI and PII security policies.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Azure Cloud Architecture and Services · Version Control · REST APIs · Cloud Migration Strategies

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description: In this role, I have created and facilitated scalable service-oriented architecture solutions along with responsive web front end at Intuition LLC. Furthermore, I leveraged MSMQ for durable message queuing, ensuring reliable communication/transaction handling across systems. Moreover, I designed and recommended robust solutions integrating multiple internal and external APIs by leveraging C#, .NET Framework, MVC4, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, and SQL.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure Cloud Architecture and Services · Version Control · REST APIs

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
During this tenure, I spearheaded and drove development efforts on 12 applications and served as backup developer for an additional 12 applications. I led all aspects of development and support as the sole engineer for two pivotal applications, demonstrating leadership and technical proficiency despite junior-level designation. Additionally, I delivered crucial maintenance and support for the agency's main report-writing system, ensuring continuity and reliability while managing concurrent software development initiatives.

Signature Accomplishments
• Sex Kit Online Tracking - Cold Cases: Designed and developed an innovative online tracking system.
• Enhanced functionality to include grant tracking for Law Enforcement agencies.
• Check Point Security Application: Created a web-based utility integrating with state and federal systems for background checks at sheriff's offices and jails.
• Received accolades for setting up a forward command center during a local missing child search.
• Launched 3 new applications utilizing MVC, C# .Net Framework, with a database first design utilizing a SQL backend.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure Cloud Architecture and Services · Version Control · REST APIs
